body:
Propofol I had an endoscopy first thing in the morning the day Barac Obama was elected.  I have had nausea and vomiting for like 3 years now.  And the doctor wanted to check out the inside of my stomach for himself.  The proporfol was given through a drip.
When they started the drip I was laying down facing a window with the blinds opened and I just looked outside I think they may have had me count backwards.  The next thing I knew I asked for something to spit in and they said that means its working and the procedure is over.  I couldnt believe it I felt no onset to the drug or after effect except hunger, which was at the time something new for me with all the stomach problems I had been having.  The increased appetite side effect from this drug was good and well timed.
This drug has no rec value there is no euphoria.  If properly administered it can remove consciousness (and it didnt even feel like I was out or asleep, no dreams at all) from the patient for short periods of time without any noticeable side effects except hunger but if give improperly it could result in death.
